# Code of conduct

We welcome people with different backgrounds and levels of programming
experience. Be respectful, give specific feedback, and discuss ideas and code
without attacking the person behind them.

Harassment, discrimination, threats, sexual harassment and publishing another
person's private information are unacceptable. Do not share credentials or
personal learner records in issues, discussions or pull requests.

## Reporting concerns

Contact the maintainer through a private contact method listed on their
[GitHub profile](https://github.com/adhamahmedyousef). If none is available, open
an issue requesting private contact without naming the people involved or
publishing sensitive details.

The maintainer will review reports and may request changes, remove inappropriate
content, warn participants or restrict participation. Responses should protect
the privacy of the people involved and be proportionate to the behavior.

This policy applies to this project's issues, discussions, pull requests and
other spaces maintained for its community.
